findings.F1: Inside the falling agitated profile, the tested fade of up days is weak and rests on one year. On the 3-day grid, the slope of the next 3 days' unusual move on the positive part of the day's return in 30-day swings is -0.028 (t -1.78, 427 cases, 143 days). By year it is -0.075 (t -3.69) in 2020, against -0.045 (t -1.12) in 2018, +0.003 (t 0.36) in 2019 and +0.027 (t 0.68) in 2021.
findings.F2: Inside the same profile, the down side of the day carries as much of the slope as the up side. The slope on the negative part of the day's swing-scaled return is -0.036 (t -2.02), and days of -2 swings or worse are followed by +6.2 % unusual next-day moves (t 1.73, 29 cases, 11 days). After a 10-day fall of 1 to 2 swings, the next 5 days rise +8.4 % (t 2.58, 41 cases, 18 days). This is the falling agitated long rebound the map already holds 12 times, so it is not a discovery.
findings.F3: The tested book cannot pay at this size. Per case the unusual move is +0.43 % (t 0.97, 430 days), but the coin's drift in the short direction is -0.43 %, so the total move is 0.00 % against a trade cost of 0.22 %. The book's Sharpe is -0.03 and its yearly return -0.9 %.
findings.F4: Outside the profile, the 10-day return in 30-day swings continues over the next 5 days, the opposite of the reversal inside the profile (slope -0.031, t -2.06, 263 cases).
findings.F5: This out-of-profile 10-day continuation is graded and broad, though it is only marginally past chance given the many angles looked at.
findings.F6: Volatility level and weekday show nothing that stands out. Across the four quartiles of the 30-day swing, the 3-day unusual moves have |t| at most 0.64. On every weekday, in or out of the profile, next-day unusual moves have |t| at most 1.67.

ideas.idea: In a falling, calm market, the larger a coin's 10-day return measured in standard deviations of its daily returns over the past 30 days, the further its price moves the same way over the next 5 days, upward after strong 10-day rises and downward after strong 10-day falls.
ideas.consequence: In a calm decline a trader would follow the coin's 10-day move in proportion to its size in usual swings, rather than fade it as one would in an agitated decline.
ideas.name: falling calm swing momentum

ideas.idea: In a choppy market, the larger a coin's 10-day return measured in standard deviations of its daily returns over the past 30 days, the further its price moves the same way over the next 5 days.
ideas.consequence: In a market going nowhere over 60 days, a trader would lean with a strong 10-day move in proportion to its size in usual swings, on either side.
ideas.name: choppy market swing momentum
